## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

### 1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS
- **No Inline CSS:** The `style="..."` attribute is forbidden. Inline event-handler attributes (`onclick`, etc.) are also forbidden.
- **Class/ID Selectors Only:** Every design property, layout rule, and state is applied via class or ID selectors in `style.css`.
- **Minimal HTML Modifications:** Semantic HTML5 (`header`, `nav`, `main`, `section`, `article`, `footer`). Markup stays clean and styling-agnostic — a full retheme must require CSS edits only.

### 1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens
All tokens defined in `:root` and remapped for dark mode:
- **Colors:** `--primary` (ink `#1a1a1a`), `--secondary` (soft brown `#c4a882`), `--bg-primary` (cream `#f5f3ee`), `--bg-secondary` (`#faf8f4`), `--bg-accent` (`#e8d4c0`), `--text-primary` (`#1a1a1a`), `--text-secondary` (`#555555`), `--text-success`, `--text-error`, `--border-default` (`#1a1a1a`), `--border-error`, `--border-success`.
- **Success/Error:** Choose muted, era-appropriate values (e.g., deep green / brick red) that pass WCAG AA in both themes.
- **Contrast Pairing:** Every light background token pairs with a dark text token and every dark background token pairs with a light text token — enforced in every theme, not just the default.
- **Light Mode Background:** Cream `#f5f3ee`; never pure white; use `#fefefe` only if a near-white is truly unavoidable.
- **Radius & Shadows:** `--radius-sm: 0`, `--radius-md: 2px`, `--radius-lg: 6px` (sharp editorial corners; only geometric dots/circles are round); `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (soft warm-tinted, e.g., `rgba(26,26,26,0.08)`), plus `--shadow-hard: 6px 6px 0 var(--primary)` for hover offset effects.
- **Spacing & Transitions:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`; `--transition-fast: 150ms`; `--transition-normal: 300ms` (spec-mandated); `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1)`.
- **Elevation/Stacking:** `--z-dropdown: 100`, `--z-modal: 200`, `--z-toast: 300`.
- **Fonts:** `--font-display: 'Fraunces', serif`; `--font-base: 'Work Sans', sans-serif`.

### 1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support
- **Implementation:** Define dark tokens under both `@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)` and a `.dark` class — a warm ink palette (e.g., `--bg-primary: #17130f`, `--bg-secondary: #201b15`, `--text-primary: #f5f3ee`, `--text-secondary: #b3aca0`, `--border-default: #f5f3ee`, with `#c4a882` and `#e8d4c0` repurposed as readable accents). Verify AA contrast.
- **Theme Switching:** Background, text, and border variables must swap with zero HTML restructuring.
- **Persistence:** User choice persists via `localStorage`, falling back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; a visible header toggle with correct `aria-pressed`/`aria-label` and a Material `dark_mode`/`light_mode` icon.

### 1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment
- **Default Alignment Rule:** Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified (note it in a CSS comment).
- **Mobile-Friendly First:** All rows collapse to columns on small viewports; zero horizontal scrolling from 320px up; fluid `clamp()` sizing throughout.

### 1.5 Styling Approach
Clean, hand-authored custom CSS in `style.css` (no framework build step), per the technical specification. All reusable classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, `.geo-*`, `.cta-bordered`) must map back to the CSS variables above.

### 1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)
- **Text:** Google Fonts `<link>` tags for Fraunces (700, 900, italic 700) and Work Sans (400, 500), bound to `--font-display`/`--font-base`.
- **Icons:** Google Material Symbols (Outlined) via the Google Fonts CDN for functional icons only (chevrons, checks, arrows, menu, social, theme toggle). Raw inline SVGs and local icon files are forbidden. Decorative art remains CSS-only geometric shapes.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

### 2.1 Button (`.btn`, `.cta-bordered`)
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum 44×44px touch target. Signature CTA: 3px solid border, `16px 32px` padding, weight 700, sharp corners.
- **Hover:** Visible shift — hard offset shadow (`var(--shadow-hard)`) + `translate(-2px, -2px)`, or a fill swap; `cursor: pointer`; 300ms transition.
- **Focus:** Distinct ring via `outline`/`box-shadow` using CSS variables; clearly visible during keyboard navigation in both themes.
- **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading:** Disables interaction, prevents double-clicks, renders a CSS spinner or rotating Material Symbol without distorting button dimensions.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, grayscale, `cursor: not-allowed`.
- **Success/Error:** Temporary feedback states styled with `--text-success`/`--text-error` (used by the Final CTA form).
- **Variants:** `.btn-primary` (ink fill, cream text), `.btn-secondary` (outlined), `.btn-ghost` — all AA-compliant in both themes.

### 2.2 Card (`.card`)
- **Default:** Flexbox column layout, `--bg-secondary` surface, 2px `--border-default` border, `--radius-md`, `--shadow-sm`, generous padding.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` and/or shadow shift (features, pricing).
- **Focus-within:** Card border highlights when a child link/button receives focus.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** Shimmer animation defined in CSS for any async content — no layout jumps.
- **Empty State:** Material Icon + clear guidance text fallback where applicable.

### 2.3 Form & Input (`.input-group`)
- **Structure:** Flex container wrapping a `<label>`, the input field, and a dedicated error feedback container.
- **States:** Empty, focused (outline ring), filled, valid (success border + Material check icon), invalid (error border, `--text-error` message, error icon), disabled, read-only.
- **Feedback:** Validation messages render in an `aria-live="polite"` region; never rely on color alone — always pair color with icon and text.

### 2.4 Modal / Popup (if any dialog is included)
- **States:** Opening, open, loading, success/error, closing — all animated via CSS transitions.
- **UX Features:** Centered flex overlay + backdrop, Material Symbol close button, keyboard focus trapping, close via `Esc` or overlay click, `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"`.

### 2.5 FAQ Accordion
`<button>` triggers with `aria-expanded` + `aria-controls`, rotating Material chevron (300ms), smooth height transition, fully keyboard operable, visible focus rings.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** Fluid sizing, no horizontal overflow; geometric decor scales down or hides on small screens and must never obscure content.
- **Smooth Animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` disables transforms, floats, shimmer, and spinners (including `scroll-behavior`).
- **Accessibility (a11y):** WCAG AA contrast in light AND dark modes; never rely solely on color to communicate state; semantic HTML5; correct ARIA roles/labels on custom widgets; logical DOM/focus order; full keyboard operability (no mouse-only interactions); `aria-live` regions for form errors, loading, and success; a skip-to-content link.
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** Every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive Actions:** None expected on this page; if any appear, `.btn-danger` must be visually distinct in both themes.
